platformFindings.touchScrollAcceptance: Real trusted touch starts/terminals and bidirectional scroll measured.

limits: Synthetic textarea/contenteditable editor models only; no real ChatGPT.

Fresh x86_64 CI emulators: three3-minute idle stages; only periodic HTTP payload cadence varies, real events remain immediate and functional recovery resets to500ms. This is a measurement-overhead comparison, not an App optimization or physical-device prediction.
Optimized release uses a disposable CI certificate; root is limited to emulator fixture evidence, while browser processes run as the normal app UID.
The existing reading recovery sample still uses native PanZoom separately from the genuine touch gate.
Warning phases show temporal correlation, not proof of cause or repair.

highCadenceFailure.interpretation: Instrumentation/ADB failure after recorded Home retention, not evidence of a proven App leak or crash. High arm did not pass20 checks.

limits: Raw smaps metadata stays in the SHA-verified CI archive; no mapped memory content was read.
Kernel reported mapping names and counters do not establish retained objects, cache ownership or a leak.
smaps reading adds observation cost and may perturb or stall the system; no direct percentage comparison with earlier no-smaps measurements.
Optional smaps counters not guaranteed by every kernel are not independently validated here; growth attribution uses required per-region RSS/PSS coverage.
No forced GC/trim, node credentials, user login, real ChatGPT, screenshots, formal App,main or public release changes.
findings: The recorded high-cadence Home growth is concentrated in writable private mappings reported as [anon:jemalloc] in content processes, with leading PSS increments20476,10404,10040KiB. This is mapping-level evidence, not allocator-stack or object-level attribution.
The low-cadence arm passed20 original functional/idle checks. The high-cadence arm failed during intrusive smaps evidence collection, so there is no accepted full matched-pair or leak verdict.
This was the approved finite attribution attempt. No expanded rerun or unbounded emulator investigation is started. The next prepared work is an independent Android in-app-network candidate.
